title: A tensor-closed compact density subcategory
statement: Use [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. For every presentably monoidal infinity category $\mathcal V$, there is a regular cardinal $\kappa$ such that $\mathcal V$ is $\kappa$-accessible and the full subcategory $\mathcal V^\kappa$ of $\kappa$-compact objects is essentially small, contains the monoidal unit, and is closed under tensor products. Here $v$ is $\kappa$-compact if $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal V}(v,-)$ preserves small $\kappa$-filtered colimits. Choose a small equivalent monoidal category $C\simeq\mathcal V^\kappa$ and write $j:C\to\mathcal V$ for its fully faithful strong monoidal inclusion. Put $P(C)=\operatorname{Fun}(C^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$, where $\mathcal S$ is the infinity category of small spaces. The functor $R:\mathcal V\to P(C)$ given by $R(v)(c)=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal V}(j(c),v)$ is fully faithful, preserves $\kappa$-filtered colimits, and identifies $\mathcal V$ with the full subcategory of $P(C)$ generated by the representables under small $\kappa$-filtered colimits. In particular every object of $\mathcal V$ is a small $\kappa$-filtered colimit of objects of $j(C)$, with these equivalences taken in the coherent infinity categories.
